messages:
marta: Quick async check — API team: for the bulk-generate endpoint (/v1/generate/bulk) do we treat model pinning the same as single-generate? i.e. Accept-Model header overrides per-request model in payload?
raj: Short answer: yes we intended parity but there are edge cases with rollouts. Why the question?
marta: A partner asked if they can pin at route-level when sending mixed-model batches. They want one header for whole batch, but items include legacy model names. Concern: should we accept mixed-model requests when header present?
anne: We historically made header override payload-level model for single requests. For bulk, we've been lax and let per-item model win if present. That's inconsistent.
simon: +1 to making behavior deterministic. Two options: (A) header-forces-all (reject if item model != header) or (B) header-as-default (header used when item omits model).
raj: Tradeoffs: A gives predictable routing & billing. B keeps backward compat for clients that include models inside items. If we flip to A, we need deprecation window and clear error codes.
marta: Proposed compromise: accept B for 30 days after rollout, emit warning header X-Compat-Warn and warn in response for any item overridden, then switch to A with 410-style validation error for mismatches. Thoughts?
anne: I like phased approach. Add an audit log event for any overridden items so CS can reach out. Also add a metric bulk.model_pin_mismatch.count.
simon: For implementation: middleware should check header and iterate items. Pseudocode: 
```
if Accept-Model header present:
  for item in payload.items:
    if item.model present and item.model != header:
      record metric and maybe emit warning
    else:
      item.model = item.model or header
```
Switch behavior based on feature-flag rollout date.
raj: API surface: define new error code `model_pin_conflict` with HTTP 409 on final mode. For warning phase return 200 with field `warnings:["model_pin_overrode_item_2"]` and response header `X-Compat-Warn: model_pin_conflict_soon`.
marta: Who owns the deprecation notice and docs? I can write the docs but need the exact wording and timeline. Suggest 30 days warning, 14 day extended window for premium customers.
anne: Product + Docs should sync. I can add the audit event and backlog the metric. SRE: please set an alert if mismatch rate spikes > 0.5% of bulk requests.
simon: Devops note: deployment plan — we can ship warning-only behind ff:bulk_pin_compat, enable globally after 2 days, then plan hard-fail 30 days after global enable. Need release train note for SDKs.
deploy-bot: deploy started for service=generator canary=3/10 commit=fa3c9a8
raj: SDKs: add client-side helper that sets per-item model to header when building requests (for clients who want to preserve old behavior). We'll add a snippet in changelog.
marta: OK — action items concise: anne add metric + audit event; simon add ff + rollout schedule; raj add error code + SDK snippet; me (marta) draft docs + deprecation email. I'll ping again with draft copy. Thanks all :thumbsup:
